set.body: Source-inspection integration follow-up from family diagnostic bounds bd-01M47BDR7J7FKGXESZFY9J370P. ConditionProfilePreparation.Worker.fit in ConditionProfileFit.scala and CompactConditionRuntime.fit in CompactCondition.scala still call the legacy family.summaries at per-voxel readout. LWU summary grid is fixed0.01s, independent of KernelBasis fineStep/tail grid; a coarse-step long-horizon family can pass scalar tail admission yet fail summary count admission only during execution. Expose an allocation-free family summary-grid capability/preflight and use it in preparation paths that actually emit summaries, propagate typed diagnosis through established errors/progress, and avoid imposing summary work on consumers that do not request it. Audit existing callback exception handling and decoded-point numeric failures separately from structural grid admission. Include before-reader/callback sentinel regressions on JVM+JS and preserve scientific summary/fit results for admitted inputs. This is source inspection only; no long-horizon fit experiment was run.
set.title: Admit sampled shape-summary grids during profile preparation before readers run
